test_III_3_directional_asymmetry_within_.methodological_correction_note: In What the Words Knew ('Every Word, for the Record', p. 95), 'inward first' is defined as a word that 'began in human life and was later handed to physics'. Consequently, the 45 `not_physics_term` words in the 80-word ledger are structurally ineligible to be 'inward first' (0/45 is guaranteed by definition), making an all-80 Fisher test circular. All headline inferential tests below are restricted strictly to the 35 physics words (`core_law` vs `secondary_physics`), with the 80-word tally retained solely as a descriptive ledger summary.

fisher_all_35_physics_words_core_vs_seco.contingency: 5/21 in core_law vs 0/14 in secondary_physics (all mixed/neutral physics words scored 0)
fisher_all_35_physics_words_core_vs_seco.candor_note: When all 15 non-directional core_law words and 6 non-directional secondary_physics words are pooled as non-hits, the one-sided 35-word Fisher exact p-value is 171/2728 ≈ 0.0627 (> 0.05).
